BOOK ONE · LESSON 092

When will ...?

什么时候要……？

A lesson on the future tense with 'will'. A time-reference table (today/tomorrow/the day after tomorrow, with morning/afternoon/evening/night variants) is followed by sixteen small pictures, each showing a different activity (rain, snow, leave, get up, arrive, finish work, have a holiday, drive home, have a haircut, telephone me, have a shave, pack his bags, sweep the floor, paint this room, repair my car, make an appointment). Students practise forming future-time questions and answers. Written exercises A (rewrite sentences in short form) and B (confirm past sentences with future-time 'too' statements) are transcribed from the textbook. Workbook practice covers 'Has done, did and will do' conversations, short forms, and situational responses. Grammar exercises practise answering 'Are you going to ...?' questions with 'will' statements and giving short answers to 'Will ...?' questions.

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Look at the time table and the sixteen pictures. For each picture, write a question using 'When will ...?' and an answer using 'will'.
看时间表和16幅小图。就每幅图用"When will ...?"提问，并用"will"作答。

Look at the time table and the sixteen pictures. For each picture, write a 'When will ...?' question and a 'will' answer.

TODAY: this morning / this afternoon / this evening / tonight
TOMORROW: tomorrow morning / tomorrow afternoon / tomorrow evening / tomorrow night
THE DAY AFTER TOMORROW: the day after tomorrow in the morning / the day after tomorrow in the afternoon / the day after tomorrow in the evening / the night after next

Written exercises A — Rewrite these sentences

Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句改写以下句子。

Example:
It will rain tomorrow.
It'll rain tomorrow.

Rewrite each sentence using the short form of 'will'.

Suggested standard short forms following the printed example pattern.

Written exercises B — Rewrite these sentences

Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句确认以下的每一句话。

Example:
It rained yesterday.
Yes, and it will rain tomorrow, too.

Confirm each past-tense sentence with a future-tense 'too' statement, following the example.

Suggested model answers following the printed example pattern.
